description:
Get that smooth cinematic rolling shot with Osmo Pocket 3 — just add an ND filter, set shutter speed to 1/30, and shoot in 4K 10-bit. Osmo Pocket 3 makes movie-level car shots totally doable. 
Ready to level up your footage? Grab your gear and start rolling!

🏎️🎥 Shot by @kaudin
